summary: This was a disciplined multi-agent verification campaign in which a supervisor and five children audited seven AI-generated quantum-research archives, independently reproducing headline claims on clean copies and honestly cataloguing broken/incomplete code. Key behaviors included strong verification-before-claim, decisive self-correction, and effective steering of over-budget children, with one child (s0) drifting into editing archive source before being steered back.
